articles.title: The Stream File
articles.text: When a shelf shifted at a coastal science hall, staff protected files on solicitor (a petitioner) and spectator (a close observer). Rain kept a family inside a coastal science hall, learning about spouse (a person's partner in marriage) and spy (military a secret agent hired by a state to obtain). Near closing time at a coastal science hall, a diary linked the displays of staircase (a way of access) and stall (a compartment in a stable). The morning program at a coastal science hall paired a section on staple (usually plural a necessary commodity for which demand is constant) with one on statesman (a man). A visitor entered a coastal science hall asking about stereo (reproducer in) and left with a note on stream (a natural body of running water flowing on or under).
articles.translation: 海岸科学馆的架子倒下时，员工保护了有关律师（solicitor）的材料，也找回了旁边关于观众,旁观者（spectator）的档案。雨天让一家人留在海岸科学馆，一个孩子学习配偶(指夫或妻)。（spouse），另一个孩子则操作与间谍v. 当间谍,刺探（spy）有关的模型。海岸科学馆闭馆前，一本提到楼梯（staircase）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有分隔栏（stall）的画的主人。海岸科学馆的上午活动把订书钉,U形钉（staple）与另一项关于政治家,政客（statesman）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。访客到海岸科学馆询问立体声录音机（stereo），旧平面图却意外引导她发现了小河,溪流（stream）。

articles.title: Understanding Spectrum Through Evidence
articles.text: To avoid ambiguity, a coastal science hall explains spectrum as an ordered array of the components of an emission and spice as aromatic substances of vegetable origin used as a preservative. Field notes from a coastal science hall distinguish spine (the series of vertebrae forming the axis of the skeleton) from sponge (a porous mass of interlacing fibers). A chart in a coastal science hall defines sprinkle as a light shower and stalk as material on different branches. Students at a coastal science hall summarize stump as the base part of a tree and suspension as a mixture in, then test new examples. The glossary at a coastal science hall defines synthesis as the process of producing a chemical compound and cross-references sociology, meaning the study and classification of human societies.
articles.translation: 为避免歧义，海岸科学馆的教师分别说明光谱,系列（spectrum）和香料,调味品（spice），再用实例展示各自用法。海岸科学馆的野外记录严格区分脊骨,书脊,地面隆起地带,中心,剌（spine）和海绵,海绵状物,松糕（sponge），使记录保持准确。海岸科学馆的图表把洒,喷,淋（sprinkle）和茎,梗vt. 悄悄地跟踪vi. 高视阔步地走（stalk）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。海岸科学馆的学生分别概括树桩,残茬,参与部分,残肢 v.僵硬地走,使为难（stump）与吊, 悬浮, 悬浮液, 暂停, 中止, 悬而未决, 延迟。（suspension），随后检验新实例是否符合定义。海岸科学馆的词汇表定义综合,合成法,合成物（synthesis），并以交叉索引引导读者查看社会学（sociology），但不把二者视为相同。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

articles.title: Why Stereotype Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Decision makers at a coastal science hall cannot evaluate solidarity (a union of interests or purposes or sympathies among members) while excluding solo (any activity). A proposal for a coastal science hall prioritizes specialty (an asset of special worth or utility), while critics emphasize species (biology taxonomic group whose members can interbreed). Long-term planning at a coastal science hall needs indicators for specification (a detailed description of design criteria for a piece) and independent scrutiny of spectacle (something or someone seen). Residents near a coastal science hall debated squad (a smallest army unit) and standpoint (a mental position), then requested written evidence. Public trust at a coastal science hall needs honest discussion of statement (a message) and measurable commitments on stereotype (a conventional or formulaic conception or image).
articles.translation: 海岸科学馆的决策者不能只评估团结一致（solidarity），却把独奏（solo）排除在公开证据之外。海岸科学馆的方案优先处理特性,性质（specialty），批评者则认为生物的种（species）也应得到同等关注。海岸科学馆的长期规划应公布载明,详述（specification）指标，也应允许独立人员审查有关(pl.)眼镜（spectacle）的主张。海岸科学馆附近居民讨论班（squad）和立场,观点（standpoint）后，要求书面说明成本与责任。海岸科学馆要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论声明,陈述（statement），并对印]铅版, 陈腔滥调, 老套。vt.使用铅版, 套用老套, 使一成不变。（stereotype）作出可衡量承诺。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
